steps.label: A simple start
steps.narration: This is the MAX TOUR customer experience. From the very first screen, the traveller immediately understands where to begin, what the service offers, and how to move forward without friction.

steps.label: Browse options
steps.narration: One tap opens the live tour catalogue. The customer sees available experiences, prices, formats, and the essential information needed to compare options quickly and confidently.

steps.label: Discover the right tour
steps.narration: The interface keeps discovery visual and easy. Instead of searching through messages or long pages, the traveller can simply browse, understand the offer, and choose the experience that feels right.

steps.label: Tour details
steps.narration: Now we open Dalat Premium. The customer moves from inspiration to decision with all the important details in one place: the route, the format, the visual presentation, and the practical conditions of the trip.

steps.label: Build confidence
steps.narration: This is where the application starts doing the work of a strong sales manager. It answers the basic questions before they become objections and helps the traveller feel confident about the purchase.

steps.label: Personalize the trip
steps.narration: The customer can choose a private format and continue directly into the booking flow. The journey stays clear: select the option, confirm the trip details, and move naturally toward the reservation.

steps.label: Booking flow
steps.narration: Dates, travellers, transfer preferences, and booking information are brought into one guided path. Every next step is visible, so the customer always knows what to do next and the manager receives a much cleaner request.

steps.label: AI support
steps.narration: And when the traveller still has a question, the AI assistant is available inside the same experience. It can guide the choice, explain options, and keep the customer moving instead of losing them between channels.

steps.label: Customer journey complete
steps.narration: For MAX TOUR, this means a smoother customer journey, a stronger premium impression, and more structured enquiries. For the traveller, it feels simple, modern, and ready to book. Contact VIIVERSION to build the same premium journey for your business.

voice.instructions: Warm, modern, confident premium product-demo presenter. Natural English speech, medium energetic pace, short organic pauses, no radio-announcer cadence.
